notes: Each source clip is used whole as a key-DOWN sound. Release (up/spaceUp) is intentionally empty (upMode "none": no release sound). spaceDown is empty (falls back to the down pool). The pack config.json key mapping was NOT used: its Space/Shift/Escape assignments look swapped and could not be verified by listening. Each source clip shows two strong transients ~80–110 ms apart (possibly press + release); not confirmed by ear. See CREDITS.md.
